title: Manual check in the DAW: exported samples land on the grid
description:
## Intent
The one check a machine cannot do: the DAW actually uses what we wrote.

## Steps (manual, owner)
1. `apricity export --sidecars` on `samples/marine-band/stems/WashingtonPost/` (real stems from the library, not in git).
2. In the DAW, set the tempo to 100, drag `bass.wav` and `drums.wav` into two tracks.
3. Expect: warp on, markers on the beats, both play in time with each other and the metronome, no re-warp prompt; drums in Beats mode; the bass sounds at A440 (detune applied).
4. Record the DAW version and any deviation in a comment; file a bug under M2 for each deviation.

## Done when
The comment records a pass for at least three samples (a stem, a full recording, an unwarped sample).
